vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2109 (maintainer-repo mechanical rename + gate); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Maintainer-repo mechanical vbrief->xbrief rename plus drift gate

narratives.Description: Run the one-shot mechanical rename of the directive repo itself from the vbrief layout and tokens to xbrief, then add a gate that blocks reintroduction of the old tokens. This is a repo-wide atomic change that cannot be parallelized, so it is marked sequential and run solo as its own wave.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Use the xbrief-migrate module and a scripted pass to move the vbrief/ directory to xbrief/, rename *.vbrief.json to *.xbrief.json, and rewrite xbrief:* verbs, paths, and x-xbrief/ tokens across source, tasks, and config. 2. Add a verify gate (tasks/verify.yml + a checker module with tests) that fails when a legacy vbrief token reappears, and run the full task check suite to confirm the renamed repo is green.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the repo mechanically renamed to xbrief with a drift gate, so that the codebase uses the new layout and old tokens cannot silently return.

items.title: Given the repo, when renamed, then xbrief layout resolves and task check passes

narrative.Acceptance: Given the renamed repo, when task check runs, then the xbrief layout resolves and the full suite passes green.

items.title: Given a reintroduced legacy token, when the gate runs, then it fails and names the token

narrative.Acceptance: Given a legacy vbrief token reintroduced anywhere tracked, when the drift gate runs, then it fails and names the offending path.

items.title: Given history-sensitive paths, when renamed, then provenance references still resolve

narrative.Acceptance: Given existing references and planRefs, when the rename completes, then they are rewritten to xbrief paths and still resolve.

x-tracking.sequential_reason: repo-wide atomic rename; collides with every other file_scope, so run solo

expected_outputs: repo renamed to xbrief layout/tokens; drift gate blocks legacy-token reintroduction; task check green
